what: Callgrind instruction counts (Ir) of every arm of the expanse-trie Callgrind harnesses and the expanse-capi smoke harness on origin/main, default features and --features packed-suffix (expanse-trie/packed-suffix for expanse-capi), with, for every arm that builds a string map, the packed build's call records that section 47.3's bounds read: shell allocations and frees, shell retirements, the shell_bytes walk, and the mem_used readings. No build containing design B was measured.

host.cpu: Intel Xeon E5-2697 v4 @ 2.30GHz, 2 sockets, 72 threads, 90 MiB L3 (2 instances)
host.os: Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS host, Linux 5.15; benches run in a Debian 13.7 container
host.role: x86_64 heavy-jobs host; not the reference benchmark host. Callgrind counts are deterministic; absolute counts differ from the CI instruction-counts job (Ubuntu 24.04, valgrind 3.27.1) through libc and valgrind version

estimators.instructions: Callgrind Ir per arm as printed by iai-callgrind, exact; deterministic, so no interval and no rounds (AGENTS.md section 8.4)
estimators.call_records: parsed from each arm's callgrind.<arm>.<id>.out (calls= records and the inclusive cost line after each); every profile's total equals the arm's printed count
estimators.shell_allocs: packed build: calls to glibc malloc from split_suffix, build_split_child, insert_deferred, olc_insert, root_or_create_shared, insert_shared, ins_slot, ExpanseDomainDict::intern's closure, ExpanseOrderedBytesMap::insert, JudySLIns and the arm's own wrapper (the insert bodies inlined into it). In the packed build every suffix is a NodeAlloc block, so the mallocs left in these are Box::new(StrNode::new()). Zero for read-only arms (cursor, get, scan, prefix, mem_used), whose wrapper mallocs are key buffers
estimators.shell_frees: packed build: calls to glibc free from dispose_node (a suffix is freed by dispose_suffix there)
estimators.shell_retires: packed build: calls to Collector::retire from dispose_node
estimators.walk_ir: inclusive Ir of every call to StrNode::shell_bytes
estimators.mem_used: base build: inclusive Ir and count of the arm wrapper's calls to SyncExpanseStrMap::mem_used

commands: git archive f65060d8 | tar -x (tracked files only; no target, no .git); find crates -name '*.rs' -exec touch {} +
the two builds ran at the same time, in two containers on the same host
provenance.load: load average 2.93 3.37 2.54 (72 threads) during the runs; Callgrind counts do not depend on load
